title: Chinese Big Pharma’s Growing Pains - The Wire China
gist: Paywalled teaser on Chinese biopharma (illustrated with Hengrui): the core framing is that China's industry is good at discovering new drugs but faces a separate, harder challenge in developing and selling them globally.

insights.claim: For China's biopharma industry, discovering new drugs is a distinct challenge from developing and commercializing them globally, implying top Chinese drugmakers face growing pains in the latter.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Chinese pharma valuations may hinge on global development/commercial execution (or licensing out) rather than discovery capability alone.
insights.quote: For China’s biopharma industry, discovering new drugs is one matter: developing and selling them globally is another.
